briefs.label: Morning Brief
briefs.title: New Stores Keep Opening in A2 While D.C. and Lansing Fight Over Cannabis's Future
briefs.top: Michigan operators are still expanding on the ground — new Ann Arbor storefronts, steady demand, and both gubernatorial campaigns now courting the industry on tax relief — even as the wholesale tax lawsuit and a soft revenue picture linger. Nationally, psychedelics momentum is accelerating (Compass Pathways nearing its NDA filing) and M&A is heating up even though the DEA's rescheduling hearing hit a procedural speed bump this week.
